subject: POC Readout & Next Steps for ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Discovery + POC success criteria (ACME Health)

Hi Jane,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful discussion about your evaluation priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the trial:

Recap / success criteria (as discussed)
- Latency: 99th percentile response < 300ms for your 8k token typical prompt mix
- Throughput: sustain ~60 concurrent sessions during peak windows
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate against your 25-case clinical extraction prompt set
- Data handling: logs retained for 30 days; no patient PII stored in logs

Proposed trial plan (high level)
- 2-week sandbox run (functional verification) + 4-week live POC (evaluation)
- Redwood will provision a dedicated sandbox model (quantized) for initial perf runs
- You’ll run the ACME evaluation set and provide feedback via the shared spreadsheet

Ownership / next steps
- Action: I’ll send the detailed evaluation plan and a draft success-criteria doc by EOD tomorrow (attached: POC_Success_Criteria_v2.docx)
- Action: Rishi will set up the technical onboarding session and baseline perf tests next Thursday
- Action: Marcus to prepare an optional commercial summary for exec review if trial meets criteria

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_v2.docx

Would you confirm the success criteria above and whether the proposed 6-week plan works for your team? If yes, we’ll lock dates and send calendar invites (including a final readout/exec decision meeting in mid-July).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.example
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + POC success criteria (ACME Health)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick recap, this looks accurate. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Latency: the 300ms 99th is acceptable as long as it’s for the quantized model we discussed; we’ll validate across our two main prompt templates.
- Quality: we’ll run the 25-case extraction set and a 50-case secondary set for edge cases. We expect detailed failure logs for any misses.
- Security: our Security team requires a short answers doc on log retention and access controls before we start the live POC — can Neha or someone on your team provide that?

Timeline: the 6-week plan looks good. Can we schedule the technical onboarding for Thu 7/8 and aim for a final readout week of 7/13-7/17? Raj would like an exec decision meeting on Tue 7/14 afternoon if possible.

Attendees for final readout (tentative): Raj Patel (CPO), Tom Reyes (Head of ML Ops), Jane Doe (Dir, Product), plus 2 engineers. Please include a short contract summary if the results are positive.

Thanks - will confirm the internal attendees and I’ll share the evaluation spreadsheet after our internal prep today.

Best,
Jane
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + POC success criteria (ACME Health)

Jane —

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Short answers and confirmed plan below.

Security / logs
- Neha will send a 1-page security summary (log retention, role-based access, KMS integrations) by Monday 7/6. That will address the Security team ask.

Detailed evaluation plan (attached: Evaluation_Plan_ACME.xlsx)
- Week 0 (7/6-7/9): Sandbox onboarding & baseline perf (Rishi lead)
  - Technical onboarding session: Thu 7/8, 10:00-11:30 PT
  - Baseline perf runs and KV/prefix caching enabled
- Week 1-4 (7/10-8/6): Live POC - run evaluation sets and monitor
  - ACME primary set (25 cases) + secondary set (50 cases)
  - Weekly check-ins: Tue 9:00 PT - short sync + error triage
- Week 5 (8/10-8/14): Final readout slides prep + exec dry run
- Decision window: Exec readout + go/no-go on Tue 8/18 (note: you requested mid-Jul; we scoped conservatively for 6 weeks from live start - if you want faster, we can compress to a 4-week live POC and keep 7/14 as readout)

Proposal to meet your preference: accelerate
- Option A (accelerated): 2-week live POC starting 7/10, final readout + exec decision Tue 7/14
- Option B (standard): 4-week live POC, exec decision Tue 8/18

Please confirm Option A or B. If Option A, we’ll compress the weekly checkpoints and focus on the primary 25-case set only.

Next steps & ownership
- Marissa: finalize success criteria & send Final_Readout_Slides_ACME.pptx template
- Rishi: technical onboarding + perf testing
- Neha: security summary doc
- Marcus: contract / commercial summary (DocuSign-ready draft attached once we agree on dates)

Attachments: Evaluation_Plan_ACME.xlsx, MVP_Runbook.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timing and commercial next steps (ACME)

Jane / Marissa -

Quick note from the commercial side: thanks for proposing the two cadence options. If ACME opts for Option A (accelerated, readout 7/14), we can have a high-level commercial summary ready for the exec meeting and a DocuSign SOW prepared that afternoon so procurement can start review. I’ll attach the draft SOW and a one-pager summary to the readout deck.

Attachment (will share once dates are locked): DocuSign_ACME_Redwood_SOW.pdf

If you confirm 7/14, Marcus will also schedule a 30-min pre-readout alignment with Raj and our GTM lead on Mon 7/13.

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC Readout & Next Steps for ACME Health - Confirming 7/14

Marissa / Marcus -

We’ll take Option A (accelerated). Confirming the following:

- Technical onboarding happened 7/8 and baseline runs look good.
- Live POC: 7/10-7/13 (primary 25-case set only)
- Final readout + exec decision: Tue 7/14, 2:00-3:00 PM PT (Raj, Tom, Jane + 2 engineers)
- Requests for readout: please include Final_Readout_Slides_ACME.pptx and a one-page commercial summary. If results meet success criteria, Raj wants procurement to have the SOW/DocuSign link ready.

We’ll send calendar invites in a few minutes. Looking forward to the readout.

Jane
